title: Easier edits and tidier PDFs
items: If you delete a Record by mistake, you now get an Undo note and can bring it back.
Download all your data and get a link by email, so you do not have to wait on the page.
Contacts are easier to manage: Edit and History sit in one bar, and Delete and Save are in the pop-up.
The Records page has a search box for titles once you have more than ten Records.
PDFs draw groups of answers in neat boxes, and you can show several Usual answer pictures on a question.
A Fault is never saved cut off with dots, and the walk's own location is not swapped for an old Usual answer.

title: Photos in Word, tidier Record page
items: The Word file draws photos four to a row, no taller than 3.5 cm, the size they are in your own reports.
The To check box and its links are gone from the Record page.

title: Re-reading a Check keeps your questions
items: If a Check already has questions, re-reading it from What does this check cover? keeps every question and only adds new ones.
Only you delete questions, on the questions page.

title: Usual answers and clearer Records
items: A question can have a Usual answer. It fills in the Record and prints after the answer.
A photo you caption now goes on the question your words describe.
The Record page, the Word file and the Link say each sentence once.
Every word beside an answer on the Record can be edited.
WhatsApp messages are shorter and end with just how to finish.
Questions with blank sub-questions are now counted properly in the score.

title: Safer restarts and more photos
items: A paying firm's Record now holds up to 250 photos.
A photo, even one captioned with words like "start again", never restarts a walk that already has answers.
If a walk has answers, saying something that sounds like a restart asks you to reply restart first.
A bare Yes to the closing message no longer ticks every other question as OK.
A Formal report in your own template no longer has a View this report online line.
On a phone or touch screen, a shared Record has no section list in the way.

title: Better photos and Word reports
items: Times in reports are shown in UK time, for example 9.08 a.m.
Each photo on a Fault is sorted as a Fault photo or an OK photo.
When you give a Fault a rating, it is kept as you said it.
Your own template's words are kept as they are in the Formal report editor.
The To do list uses only what the person said on the job.
The More button looks the same on every page.

title: Edit in the row, landscape PDFs
items: Click the words on a Record to edit them in the row, with no pop-up.
Drag photos in and out of a question. You can delete a photo and bring it back.
A deleted photo is left off the PDF and the shared page.
PDFs are now landscape, a fifth smaller, with photos as small tiles and no cover page.
The billing page shows the real due date and every invoice you have paid.
Each question can be in the score or left out, and you can choose how silence counts.

title: Two small fixes
items: A question label keeps its last word. Only the OK? and Issue? tags are tidied away.
Downloading the PDF of a Record with a great many photos now redraws it, instead of giving you an old copy.

title: Your Check can have its own logo
items: A Check can have its own logo at the top of its PDF and shared pages.
You can write answers as points or as a paragraph, and make words bold.
Each To do line can be reworded.
Photos are turned upright and placed on the question they show.
A pencil on the location card lets you set where the work was.
After you say Done, Quickler listens to every voice note again and tells the speakers apart.

title: Long voice notes and a simpler list
items: A voice note can be ten minutes long. Quickler says it is working on it while it listens.
Saying done now gets a reply to say your Record is filed.
Every Record gets a title.
The Records page is one list with the newest first.
A failed photo now says so, and does not just vanish.

title: A tidier Records page
items: The workbook download is now an Excel file with one row per Fault, and it says which walk each came from.
Shareable links say View-only.
The shared report fits a narrow phone screen.
A place with several things wrong with it is shown once.
A building's history is one click away.
Downloads now have proper names.

title: People in one place
items: All your people are now in one list, with their role shown on each row.
Voice notes are kept so you can listen to them again next to the transcript.
The shared page says Completed by.
Pop-ups no longer have a Cancel button, because the cross already closes them.
A Record is checked once more before it is filed, so Faults match the answers.

title: Small wording fixes
items: The opener now tells you to say restart if you want to begin a Check again.
Messages use plainer words.
A schedule with no valid time no longer fires by mistake.
Sign-in links no longer fail when they expire.
A payment notice from the bank is never counted twice.
Safer handling of names and labels you type in.
